BROKER_BOUNDARY: All writable outputs must route through broker; workload cannot write alternate files, inherited descriptors or uncontrolled streams. Existing source has no independently qualified all-producer broker. Requires separately approved exact source/host sandbox scope.
CRITICAL_WRITER_OWNER: Independent qualified observer/broker, not terminated workload
MINIMAL_BROKER_INTERFACE: Fixed closed record-type enum + fixed producer token + canonical bounded record bytes; no arbitrary path. Descriptor-based writer validates schema, serializes concurrent requests, precharges entire submitted buffer against normal/reserve ledger, publishes once no-overwrite and applies durability barriers. No delete/overwrite refund or automatic write retry.
POST_DEADLINE_FINALIZATION: Separate finite governed finalization window, CPU/memory/FD and reserve access. Ends workload authority permanently; never restarts or reopens claim. Duration undefined, no ledger bypass permitted.
